title: Heavenly Fluffy Greek Malt Pie
description: A light, malty pie with puff pastry crust, a creamy Greek yogurt filling, and a subtle dashi‑sweetness, perfect for a low‑fat dessert.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking pan with parchment.
Roll out one puff pastry sheet into a 20x20 cm square and place it in the pan, pressing gently.
In a bowl, whisk together Greek yogurt, malt syrup, dashi extract, honey, lemon zest, salt, and egg white until smooth.
Pour the mixture over the pastry, spreading evenly.
Cover the top with the second puff pastry sheet, sealing edges with a fork.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden and puffed.
Remove, let cool for 5 minutes, then cut into squares.
Drizzle with a small amount of honey if desired and serve warm.
